subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app 2026.6.11 fails codesign/spctl despite valid DMG checksum

question: Should OpenClaw reissue the v2026.6.11 macOS DMG/zip after live Apple Silicon signature verification, or leave remediation for the next stable release?
rationale: Only release maintainers can access the restricted signing/publish lane and decide whether replacing a stable macOS artifact is safer than deferring with user guidance.

options.title: Verify and reissue macOS assets
options.body: Run the restricted macOS validation/publish path and replace the affected stable DMG/zip only after copied-app `codesign` and `spctl` proof passes.

options.title: Defer to next stable
options.body: Keep the issue open with guidance telling users to wait for the next stable macOS artifact if same-version replacement is too risky.

options.title: Close only with artifact proof
options.body: Close only if maintainers prove the existing or rebuilt artifact passes the reporter's verification path on Apple Silicon.

recommendation.title: Verify and reissue macOS assets
recommendation.body: Run the restricted macOS validation/publish path and replace the affected stable DMG/zip only after copied-app `codesign` and `spctl` proof passes.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest current history match for the macOS packaging, signing, DMG, workflow, and v2026.6.11 release surface.
